I started out building front-end features for a healthcare web application in JavaScript, studied Applied Computer Science at Karel de Grote Hogeschool, and have kept building since: WordPress and Elementor sites, a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, JSON-LD structured data, and an Android app live on Google Play. I also know how business needs become interfaces: translating client requirements into site structures and content models, and reporting on performance with Google Analytics and Search Console.

I'm based in Belgium, work fluently in English, and would welcome a conversation about the role.

cover_letter:
Dear Halian team,

I'd like to apply for the Front-End Developer (React / TypeScript) position in Brussels.

My route into front-end work started on the code side. At ViviDoctor I developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application in AngularJS and JavaScript, and before that I completed Applied Computer Science coursework at Karel de Grote Hogeschool in Antwerp. Since then my career has moved through web and SEO work, but the building never stopped. I've designed and shipped sites in WordPress and Elementor, written a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero and accessible markup, implemented JSON-LD schema and knowledge-graph markup, and built an Android app that is live on Google Play.

That mix matters here. I understand interfaces, but I also understand what sits behind them: how a business requirement becomes a site structure or a content model, and how data turns into reporting someone can act on. I work daily with Google Analytics and Search Console, tracking performance and translating it into decisions, and I'm used to collaborating with business and technical colleagues through delivery. I'm comfortable with the iterative side of delivery too: testing what I build, watching how people actually use it, and refining from there.

I should be upfront: React and TypeScript are where I'm actively building skills now, rather than two years of production experience. My JavaScript foundation, computer science coursework and a record of shipping working software are what I'd bring while I close that gap quickly.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, within reach of Brussels, work fluently in English, and would genuinely enjoy helping Halian's clients build data-driven applications that people find easy to use.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com

- Works across business and technical teams: delivered SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo at KXP; fluent English, based in Belgium near Brussels
